chunks: Then he (peace be upon him and his family) said: Surely, Gabriel, the Trustworthy Spirit, descended upon me from the Lord of the Worlds and said: 'O Muhammad! Betake to good character, for surely poor character takes away the good of this world and the Hereafter.' Verily, the most resembling of you to me is the best of you in character.

key_terms.حُسْنِ الْخُلُقِ: Good character: the prophetic ideal of moral excellence that Gabriel urged the Prophet to adopt

ai.seo_question: What did Gabriel say to the Prophet about good character in al-Amali of Sheikh al-Saduq?
ai.summary: Continuing the narration, the Prophet (SAWW) relates that Gabriel descended from God commanding him to adopt good character, warning that poor character destroys the benefits of both worlds. The Prophet adds that the closest of his followers to him are those with the finest character.
